subject: valkey-cli make source node ignores NOREPLICAS when doing the last CLUSTER SETSLOT (#928)
reason: The change is confined to valkey-cli's cluster manager: clusterManagerMoveSlot now treats a NOREPLICAS reply to the final CLUSTER SETSLOT <slot> NODE on the source primary as benign (valkey-cli.c:5044). That reply only occurs on a multi-primary cluster where the source primary pre-replicates SETSLOT to at least one online >=7.4 replica, blocks the client (cluster_legacy.c:6312-6326), and the replicas migrate to another primary during the block so the ack wait times out (blocked.c:245) - i.e. mid slot-migration driven by valkey-cli --cluster rebalance/reshard.
